welcome: Hi officer! The chief is waiting for you at the police station!
hint-chief: The chief has a job for you. Walk to the chief!
chief-later: Great work today! Come back soon!
chief-need-bike: You need a police bike for the next job. Buy one at the shop!
intro-first-day: Welcome to your first day! Here's your police cap. Hop in your car and drive through the three red flags!
siren-now: Great driving! Now press the siren button!
traffic-now: Now help the ducks cross the road. Walk to the yellow circle with the traffic light!
hint-pad: Walk to the yellow circle to play!
pad-other-job: That game is for another job. Put on that uniform to play it!
done-first-day: You did it! Your first day as a police officer!
intro-donut-dash: Oh no, Pickles is up to something! Hop in your police car!
hint-car: Your police car is right here. Tap it to hop in!
hint-bike: Your police bike is right here. Tap it to hop on!
chase-start: Oh no! Pickles took all the donuts! Wee-oo, let's catch him!
hint-chase: Catch the robber! Bump his car, or tap the net button!
out-of-gas: Uh oh! He ran out of gas!
mission-done: Great job, officer! You caught Pickles!
tower-sneak: Uh oh! Look who's sneaking out of Time-Out Tower!
intro-duck-crossing: Quack! A mother duck and her ducklings are lost on the road. Walk to them, and lead them to the pond!
ducks-follow: Quack quack! The ducks are following you!
ducks-wait: Wait! The ducks are too far behind. Go back for them!
ducks-kerb: Cars are coming! Press the siren to stop the cars!
hint-pond: Lead the ducks to the pond!
done-duck-crossing: The ducks are home! Quack quack, thank you!
badge: You earned your police badge! You're a real police officer now!
intro-rooftop-run: Smudge grabbed the mayor's rubber duck and zoomed off on his scooter! Hop on your police bike!
chase-smudge: There goes Smudge! He's riding through the park!
hint-mayor: Bring the rubber duck back to the mayor!
done-rooftop-run: My rubber duck! Thank you, officer!
intro-lost-puppy: A puppy is lost! Listen for the barking, and look for paw prints!
not-here: Not here! Listen for the barks!
puppy-found: You found the puppy! Take him back to his family!
hint-find: Follow the barks and the paw prints!
hint-owner: Take the puppy back to his family!
done-lost-puppy: My puppy! Thank you so much!
intro-double-trouble: Double trouble! Both Bandit Brothers took the last left sock! Hop in your police car!
chase-both: They split up! Catch them both!
who-took-it-now: Now find out who has the sock! Walk to the yellow circle with the magnifying glass!
done-double-trouble: You caught them both, and found the sock! Super officer!
errand-offer: My donuts! Can you bring them back?
hint-errand: Bring it to the person with the picture bubble!
errand-done: Thank you! Here are some coins!
errand-socks: My socks! Can you bring them back?
errand-rubber-duck: I lost my other rubber duck in the park. Can you find it?
errand-balloon: Can you take this balloon to the chief?
minigame-intro: Tap the light to stop the cars, so the ducks can cross!
wti-intro: Who took it? Look at the picture, and tap the one who has it!
shop-not-yet: Not yet! Play some more games to get more coins!
board-hello: Pick a mission to play again!
pickles-back: Uh oh, Pickles snuck out again!
job-locked: Earn your first badge, then you can try another job!
job-fire: You're a firefighter now! Go see the fire chief at the fire station!
job-cop: You're a police officer again! The chief is at the police station!
job-builder: You're a builder now! The foreman is at the building site by the harbor!
intro-siren-school: Welcome to the fire station! Here's your helmet. Hop in the fire truck and drive through the three flags!
hint-truck: Your fire truck is right here. Tap it to hop in!
spray-now: Now spray the practice fire! Press the hose button!
hint-spray: Spray the fire! Press the hose button!
hint-fire-far: Drive close to the fire, then press the hose button!
too-high: It's too high! You need a longer ladder from the shop!
intro-kitty: A kitten is stuck high up on the yellow tower! Drive the fire truck to the tower!
hint-rescue: Park the fire truck next to the tower!
done-kitty: Meow! The kitten is safe! Thank you!
intro-toaster: Oh no, the toaster is on fire! Walk into the house with the red roof door!
hint-door: Walk to the door to go inside!
kitchen-hello: Tap the little flames to spray them!
kitchen-done: All out! And the toast is ready!
done-toaster: Thank you, firefighter! Toast for everyone!
intro-bbq: The barbecue in the park got too hot! Drive there and spray the fires!
done-bbq: The barbecue is safe! Hot dogs for everyone!
intro-fireworks: The fireworks went off by mistake! Spray the sparkly fires on the towers!
done-fireworks: Pretty, but safe now! Great job!
intro-tallest: There's a fire on top of the tallest tower, and a parrot is stuck on the roof! Use your extra long ladder!
done-tallest: Squawk! Thank you! You're the best firefighter in town!
errand-cake: Can you take this cake to the fire chief?
errand-find-balloon: My balloon flew into the park! Can you find it?
ws-intro: Splash the flames in the windows! Tap them!
lr-intro: Hold to raise the ladder. Let go when it reaches the cat!
hint-mixer: Your cement mixer is right here. Tap it to hop in!
intro-hard-hat: Welcome to the building site! Here's your hard hat. Hop in the cement mixer and drive through the three cones!
build-now: Now build! Press the block button to blast blocks!
hint-build: Park near the outline, then press the block button!
done-hard-hat: Great building! You're a real builder!
intro-dock: The boats need a dock! Drive to the water and build the dock!
done-dock: Toot toot! The boat can dock now! Thank you!
intro-mixer: The cement is ready! Drive it to three places around town before it gets hard!
hint-pour: Drive the cement mixer to the flags!
done-mixer: What a cement mixer! Great job!
intro-lighthouse: Ships can't see the island at night! Build a lighthouse on the island!
done-lighthouse: The light is on! Ships are safe now! Thank you!
intro-boat-shop: The boat owner needs a shop! Build the boat shop!
done-boat-shop: My new boat shop! It's wonderful!
intro-bridge: Let's build a bridge to the tiny island!
hint-island: Walk across the bridge to the island!
done-bridge: You built a bridge! Now everyone can visit the island!
errand-wrench: I lost my wrench at the building site! Can you find it?
errand-pizza: Can you take this pizza to the boat owner?
bs-intro: Tap to drop the block! Stack them up high!
cb-intro: Copy the picture! Tap the squares to change their color!
cp-intro: Hold to pour the cement. Let go at the line!
errand-teddy: I lost my teddy bear in the park! Can you find it?
errand-flowers: Can you take these flowers to grandma? She loves flowers!
errand-book: Can you take this book to the lighthouse keeper?
errand-letter: Can you take this letter to the foreman at the harbor?
errand-present: Can you take this present to the police chief? It is a surprise!
errand-fish: My fish jumped out of the bucket! Can you find it?
errand-icecream: Can you take this ice cream to the kid by the tall towers? Quick, before it melts!
errand-kitten: Oh no, my kitten ran off again! Can you find her?
errand-feather: I lost a beautiful feather in the park by the towers. Can you find it?
errand-apple: I dropped an apple somewhere downtown. Can you find it?
errand-shell: I want a shell from the tiny island. Can you find one?
home-hello: Welcome home! Drag your things where you like them!
car-yours: Your very own car! It is parked by your apartment!
hint-car-own: Your own car is right here. Tap it to hop in!
finale-ready: Help! The mayor needs you right away!
intro-finale-1: Oh no! The Bandit Brothers took the Golden Block! They made smoky fires on the tallest tower so nobody can see them. Firefighter, put them out!
done-finale-1: The smoke is gone! Look, they are getting away in a helicopter!
intro-finale-2: Quick, officer! Chase the helicopter in your police car, and catch it with your net!
done-finale-2: You got the Golden Block back! Now let us build it a new tower!
intro-finale-3: Builder, build a brand new Golden Block tower in the plaza!
done-finale-3: You saved the city! Hooray! Let us have a parade!
parade: It is a parade! Thank you, hero of Block City!
morning: Good morning, Block City! There is always more to do!
